scientific_integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from standard background definitions. The accompanying finite checker independently verifies counts, but does not stand in for the asymptotic inequality or originality assessment.
scientific_limitations: Exact all-gap spectrum and sharp leading asymptotic extremal coefficient for linear binary words with precisely three ones. The exact finite-length extremal quasipolynomial, its finite extremizer classes, and higher weights are not asserted. Search-based originality is provisional; computational tests are finite.
title: Sharp quadratic envelope for distinct palindromic subsequences of three-marker binary words
